notes.title: "MOMO Crash" Video Streaming & Posting Guideline(Updated 25.09.05)
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for your interest in "MOMO Crash." To allow more people to experience the charm of this work, and to ensure that content creators can engage in their activities with peace of mind, we have established the following guidelines for video and stream posting regarding this work. Please read these guidelines and enjoy the world of "MOMO Crash" while adhering to the rules![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]1. General Principles and Scope of Permission[/b][/h3][p]For "MOMO Crash" (hereafter referred to as "this work"), the posting of gameplay streams (live streaming) and videos (hereafter referred to as "video content") on the internet by individual customers is, in principle, not an issue as long as it is within the scope of these guidelines. However, actions that fall under the prohibited acts described later will not be permitted.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]2. Usable Content[/b][/h3][p]Streaming and video posting of the [b]rhythm game portion[/b] of this work (including the play screen, result screen, and effects) is not an issue as long as it is within the scope of these guidelines. The title screen and menu screens are also included.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]3. Restrictions Regarding Story Mode[/b][/h3][p]While we have restrictions on the story of this work to prevent spoilers, [b]we welcome the publication of each character's episodes #01 and #02[/b] to help people get to know the work. [b]The streaming and posting of the story from episode #03 onwards (including gameplay footage and animation) is prohibited.[/b] Cutting out and publishing the animation parts of the story mode (cutscenes, event videos, etc.) by themselves is prohibited. Please only use them as they appear as part of a gameplay stream. Also, the act of transcribing and publishing the story's text or dialogue (full transcriptions, read-alouds, etc.) is also prohibited.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]4. Monetization[/b][/h3][p]Monetization using the systems provided by video streaming sites (YouTube, Twitch, etc.), such as advertisements, Super Chat, and channel memberships, is not an issue as long as it is within the scope of these guidelines. If you wish to use video content for direct commercial purposes by other means (including corporate projects and tie-ups), separate permission from our company is required.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]5. Use of In-Game Assets (Music, Illustrations, etc.)[/b][/h3][p]Assets included in this work, such as music, character illustrations, background images, and UI, are not an issue as long as they are used as part of the game screen within the scope of your gameplay commentary and introduction videos. However, extracting assets for standalone use, or altering, redistributing, or selling them is strictly prohibited.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]6. Prohibited Content and Activities[/b][/h3][p]The following acts are prohibited. If a violation is confirmed, our company reserves the right to request the removal of video content, cessation of streams, etc.[/p][list][*][p]The disclosure of footage or content from [b]episode #03 onwards[/b] for each character in the story mode.[/p][/*][*][p]The act of disclosing the story's text, direction, acting, etc., in a form that can be understood by third parties (including screenshots, transcriptions, read-alouds, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Posts that include material contrary to laws or public order and morals, or that infringe upon the rights of third parties.[/p][/*][*][p]Content that includes discriminatory, violent, or obscene expressions, hate speech, or other material that may cause discomfort to others.[/p][/*][*][p]Use for the purpose of specific religious activities, political activities, or similar objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]Content that intentionally obstructs the gameplay experience, or promotes or encourages the exploitation of in-game bugs or specifications (cheating, hacking, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]The act of spreading false information about our company or third parties.[/p][/*][*][p]The act of spreading commentary or imagery about the theme or content of "MOMO Crash" that is grossly misleading, or excessively vulgar, violent, or sexually biased.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]7. Source Attribution[/b][/h3][p]When posting videos, we ask that you include the URL of the game's Steam store page in the video's description section whenever possible. 
(Example: "MOMO Crash" Steam Store Page: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077570"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3077570[/url]）[/p][p]When live streaming, we would appreciate it if you could state the name of this work in the description section or during the stream.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]8. Other[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The contents of these guidelines are subject to change without notice at the discretion of our company. Please always check the latest guidelines.[/p][/*][*][p]For matters not covered in these guidelines, please follow the Steam and STOVE Terms of Service, and the terms of use of each streaming platform.[/p][/*][*][p]In the event that we discover a post that violates these guidelines, our company may request its removal or the cessation of the stream.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]9. Inquiries[/b][/h3][p]For any questions regarding these guidelines or for consultations on uses not covered above, please contact the support email address below. Support Email Address: [url="mailto:info@skoota.jp"]info@skoota.jp[/url][/p][p]The entire development team sincerely looks forward to seeing your wonderful and creative content![/p]

notes.title: 『MOMO Crash』 Demo v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132154/7c6b0a8d9d872a127b8de8a320373fcc88edb0f1.png[/img]
Hello, Users! We are the 『MOMO Crash』 Development Team, dedicated to spreading the love for thighs throughout the world.
Are you enjoying the current demo version? Ahead of the Steam Next Fest, we've released the Demo v1.1.0 update to provide an even more enjoyable play experience!
Please check below for detailed changes!

■ New Thigh Warriors "SEIKA" & "HIKARU" Now Playable!
1. You can play all three existing songs with them right away, including their tutorials!

■ Main Gameplay
1. Adjusted the judgment timing for some notes to make playing more comfortable. The window for a "Perfect" judgment is now slightly wider.
2. Fixed a thigh animation error that occurred when the "Grip" and "Kick" buttons were pressed simultaneously.
3. Fixed an issue where Kitty Notes would not be judged correctly (or would react unintentionally) if the "Grip" button ([Z] key) was being held down.(Explanation: Kitty Notes require a separate long press of the [Z] key. This fix prevents Kitty Notes from misbehaving if the [Z] key is already held down for a "Grip" action.)
4. Revised some guide texts in the tutorial for greater clarity.

■ Title Screen
1. Reduced instances where the cursor could unintentionally move to the "EXIT" button.

■ Result Screen
1. Fixed an issue so that the difficulty indication is no longer displayed on the tutorial result screen.

We will continue to listen carefully to your valuable feedback and strive to create an even more fun Thigh Paradise.
Thank you for always enjoying the demo version! We look forward to your continued interest and feedback.

Sincerely,
The 『MOMO Crash』 Development Team
SKOOTA GAMES / SCOOTER FILMS.INC

notes.title: [Breaking News] Steam Next Fest Participation! Offical PV Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We would like to share some exciting news with our loyal fans who have been supporting "Momo Crash" throughout its development!

We are pleased to announce that our passion-filled new rhythm game sensation, "Momo Crash"—featuring a unique "thigh-focused" gameplay concept—has been selected to participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 🎉
The entire development team has been eagerly anticipating this moment...!

To celebrate this participation, we're unveiling the following content starting today!

[h3]🌟 Part 1: Revealing the Brand-New Key Visual![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132154/7c6b0a8d9d872a127b8de8a320373fcc88edb0f1.png[/img]

We're proud to present the team's ultimate masterpiece—the game's official key visual that will represent "Momo Crash"!

This single image captures the confident, powerful thighs of our three thigh-warrior characters, along with the stylish and energetic world that "Momo Crash" aims to create.
This visual masterpiece is packed with the development team's passion and attention to detail—we invite you to examine every detail!

[h3]🌟 Part 2: Special PV Debut for Steam Next Fest Participation![/h3]
[previewyoutube=Q5qxP-51z4E;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, to commemorate our participation in Steam Next Fest and to further enhance the excitement of this festival, we're introducing a brand new promotional video!
This video showcases the fast-paced rhythm gameplay and unique characters of "Momo Crash" in all their glory.
We encourage you to enjoy this PV alongside the key visual as we look forward to the Next Fest together!

▼Watch the commemorative PV here!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q5qxP-51z4E
